record.paper_title: Some Open Problems on Multiple Ergodic Averages
record.original_question: For every probability-measure-preserving system (X, X, μ, T) and bounded measurable functions f, g, h, do the multiple ergodic averages (1/N) Σ_{n=1}^N f(T^n x) g(T^{2n} x) h(T^{3n} x) and (1/N) Σ_{n=1}^N f(T^n x) g(T^{n^2} x) converge for μ-almost every x?

evidence.quote: Problem 11. Let (X, X , µ, T) be a system and f, g, h ∈ L∞(µ) be functions. Show that the averages (1/N) ΣN n=1 f(T^n x) · g(T^2n x) · h(T^3n x) and the averages (1/N) ΣN n=1 f(T^n x) · g(T^n^2 x) converge pointwise almost everywhere.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(X,\mathcal{X},\mu,T)$ be a probability-measure-preserving system; that is, $(X,\mathcal{X},\mu)$ is a probability space and $T:X\to X$ is a measurable map with $\mu(T^{-1}A)=\mu(A)$ for every $A\in\mathcal{X}$. For functions $f,g,h\in L^\infty(\mu)$, consider the multiple ergodic averages
$$A_N(x)=\frac{1}{N}\sum_{n=1}^{N} f(T^n x)\, g(T^{2n} x)\, h(T^{3n} x),\qquad B_N(x)=\frac{1}{N}\sum_{n=1}^{N} f(T^n x)\, g(T^{n^2} x).$$
Prove or disprove the following:
(a) For every such system and all $f,g,h\in L^\infty(\mu)$, the sequence $A_N(x)$ converges as $N\to\infty$ for $\mu$-almost every $x\in X$.
(b) For every such system and all $f,g\in L^\infty(\mu)$, the sequence $B_N(x)$ converges as $N\to\infty$ for $\mu$-almost every $x\in X$.
artifact.status_search_result: Part (b), the bilinear average $\frac{1}{N}\sum f(T^n x)g(T^{n^2}x)$, was resolved by Krause, Mirek and Tao (Annals of Mathematics, 2022), who proved pointwise a.e. convergence for bilinear polynomial ergodic averages with a polynomial of degree $\ge 2$. Part (a), pointwise a.e. convergence of the trilinear average $\frac{1}{N}\sum f(T^n x)g(T^{2n}x)h(T^{3n}x)$ for a general measure-preserving system, remains open as of the latest available references; only norm convergence (Host–Kra, Ziegler) and special-case results (e.g., distal systems) are known.

status_evidence.title: Pointwise ergodic theorems for non-conventional bilinear polynomial averages
status_evidence.snippet: Krause, Mirek, Tao established pointwise a.e. convergence of bilinear polynomial ergodic averages including f(T^n x) g(T^{p(n)} x) for polynomials p of degree at least 2.
status_evidence.claim: Bilinear case (part b) with p(n)=n^2 is solved by Krause–Mirek–Tao (2022).

status_evidence.title: Pointwise ergodic theorems for non-conventional bilinear polynomial averages (Tao's blog)
status_evidence.snippet: First joint extension of Bourgain's polynomial ergodic theorem and the bilinear ergodic theorem.
status_evidence.claim: Confirms resolution of the bilinear polynomial pointwise convergence problem.

status_evidence.title: Pointwise convergence of double ergodic averages along certain non-polynomial sequences
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work continues to extend bilinear pointwise convergence; the general trilinear case along linear iterates remains an active open problem.
status_evidence.claim: Trilinear case (part a) is not known in general; remains open.
